layers.label: USGS 3DEP terrain
layers.reason: Flag off by default. Toggles in Layers are remembered. Archive is not uploaded until owner YES. Zoom 6 is partial; zooms 7–8 are not in this archive.
layers.fallback: Skipped with a layer-unavailable note when the archive is missing or the host is down. Missing or black tiles keep the current globe elevation.
